page.notes: Right-hand text is a page-running head; "T 3" is a gathering signature. Doubtful readings: "bene(?)dæ" (printed "benda" with a faint letter), "virmagnus" printed as such (Cicero's "vir magnus"), "pricipiis" and "Platonicorum" as printed. Some words are damaged by the scan, notably around "Platonici ad discenda" and "Augustinus", where the ink is partly lost.
